description.narrative: Pula is an agricultural insurance and technology company that designs and delivers innovative agricultural insurance and digital products. It aims to help smallholder farmers endure yield risks, improve their farming practices, and bolster their incomes over time.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: BII partnered with Pula AG to pilot a nascent pay-at-harvest (PAH) insurance model for farmers. The Pula investment was structured as a £5m recoverable grant to support the scale up of a pilot for a new model of smallholder farmer insurance. PAH is virtually untested in Africa, but has the potential to significantly increase smallholder uptake of agricultural insurance through addressing key cyclical affordability barriers.
